owner_decisions.source: Owner instruction in the CP-20 session, 2026-09-23 (issued as a pasted block; confirmed by the Owner in the next message)
owner_decisions.text: A message attempt counts only when a response was received and the message failed validation, decoding or integrity checks. Network stalls, timeouts, connection failures and Lead-initiated stops do not consume the per-message allowance; they are logged separately and remain bounded by the transfer and machine-hour caps. Restore the allowance of every message that lost attempts to those causes. O1 stays as recorded. No other cap changes.

owner_decisions.implementation: src/cp20/net.py (r9), src/cp20/extract.py no-data watchdog, src/cp20/chain.py phases
owner_decisions.source: Owner standing instruction, same message as the O2 confirmation
owner_decisions.text: Run the rest of the extraction unattended. Network problems are never a reason to stop or ask. Stop only when a cap is about to be exhausted, when data contradicts the admission, when no data at all arrives for 60 minutes (then report), or when all runs are done. Harden the network layer (watchdog deadline, per-attempt buffers, backoff with jitter up to 10 minutes). Run NCAR now with 3 workers, AWS alone after NCAR finishes, and finally retry the failed days.

owner_decisions.implementation: r10; Attempts ignores integrity_failure outcomes whose detail contains "broken GRIB chain" and whose epoch precedes the first extraction job running the fix (job-code-versions.jsonl, flag locator_fix_r10); restored records logged in o2-a1-restored-attempts.jsonl
owner_decisions.source: Owner instruction in the CP-20 session, 2026-09-24 (pasted block with the Owner's own request to record per-phase code versions)
owner_decisions.text: Root cause of the NCAR "broken GRIB chain" failures: valid tiny GRIB2 messages (0/1/194 categorical ice pellets, 179-656 bytes, correct reference time) rejected by plausible()'s length > 2000 guard. Fix the locator; test with a tiny constant-field message; verify on a handful of failed days before re-running all. Do not stop the running chain. Amend O2: attempts consumed by this locator bug do not count; restore them. After the AWS phase, re-run the failed NCAR days with the fix. Record which code version each chain phase actually ran.
